deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (application opens October 1); English test scores must be verified by the same deadline.
deadline.quote: Deadline: December 1 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: ChemE does not accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: ChemE does not accept GRE scores and will not consider GRE scores in the evaluation of your application.

gre_subject.quote: will not consider GRE scores in the evaluation of your application

english_waiver.value: ChemE grants no English-test waivers under any circumstances.
english_waiver.quote: The Department of Chemical Engineering does not grant waivers for the English Language Proficiency test requirement under any circumstances.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the OGE page; the ChemE department site returned errors (502).

funding.value: All PhD/ScD students in good standing are fully funded by the department (tuition, stipend, health cover).
funding.quote: All Chemical Engineering graduate students in good standing are fully funded by the department.

entry_route.value: MIT does not require a master's degree to apply for a PhD; you can apply from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may be admitted if the degree is awarded before enrolment).
entry_route.quote: The Institute does not require applicants to hold a master’s or other advanced degree in order to apply to a Ph.D program.

notes: Duolingo 135 and Cambridge 190 accepted. Test scores must be verified before December 1, 11:59 pm EST. Also offers the PhD in Chemical Engineering Practice (PhDCEP). cheme.mit.edu pages returned 502.
